ja.title: GWAS自動解釈PGIの回収率82.1%は何を数えた値か。分母と区間を並べて読む
ja.summary: GWAS自動解釈システムPGIのプレプリントの数値を、分母と区間で読み直した。82.1%は研究ごとの回収率の平均で、経路のレベルでは完全に回収されたのが21.0%、拡張を伴う回収を含めて81.9%だった。
ja.seo_description: PGI（Post-GWAS Intelligence）のプレプリントの、回収率82.1%、ベンチマーク86.3%、1,041のGWASと530,949の証拠単位を、分母と正確な区間で整理した。

en.title: What does the 82.1% recovery of the GWAS interpretation system PGI count? Reading denominators and intervals side by side
en.summary: The numbers in the preprint of the GWAS interpretation system PGI were reread by denominator and interval. The 82.1% is a mean of per-study recovery; at the path level, fully recovered paths were 21.0% and recoveries including extension 81.9%.
en.seo_description: The recovery of 82.1%, the 86.3% benchmark, and the 1,041 GWAS with 530,949 evidence units in the PGI (Post-GWAS Intelligence) preprint, organized by denominator with exact intervals.
